question: The Binding Energy per nucleon curve is approximately horizontal (constant at ~8 MeV) for the mass range $30 < A < 170$. What does this constancy suggest about the nature of the nuclear force?

options.A: The nuclear force is infinite in range.
options.B: The nuclear force is saturated and short-ranged.
options.C: The nuclear force obeys the inverse-square law.
options.D: The nuclear force depends on electric charge.
